Cross-ref: https://www.motortradenews.com/news/rac-warns-uk-drivers-exposed-to-global-events-as-diesel-up-4p-in-10-days/
(Search snippet content — RAC's own Fuel Watch reporting language; RAC approved for motoring data only)
Latest RAC Fuel Watch: average UK petrol 153.5p per litre; diesel 168.6p per litre. Diesel up 4p in 10 days (to 168.55p). UK drivers "exposed to global events" affecting the cost of oil.
Simon Williams, RAC head of policy: "the increases are likely to keep coming thick and fast" given the rising cost of oil. Geopolitical tension between the US and Iran is driving oil volatility and subsequent rises at UK forecourts.
